An '''atmospheric-friction shield''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] fitted to [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were used when starships were required to enter [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].
